*Defines the periodic and open matrices behind Main Figure 1 and Supplement Figure S1.*

$$

### EQ002 — Fourier-dual Hatano-Nelson representation

*Connects imaginary phase to an imaginary gauge field and establishes the localization duality.*

$$

$$

### EQ004 — Determinant winding and its large-L reduction

*Generates Main Figure 1(d) and proves the transition is topological.*

$$
w=\frac{1}{2\pi i}\int_0^{2\pi}\partial_\theta\log\det[H(\theta/L,h)-E_B]d\theta=0\;(h<h_c),-1\;(h>h_c)
$$

### EQ005 — Inverse participation ratio and edge localization

*Measures bulk localization and supplies the boundary-state classification for Supplement Figure S1.*

$$
\operatorname{IPR}(\psi)=\frac{\sum_n|\psi_n|^4}{(\sum_n|\psi_n|^2)^2}
$$

